name: Sturgis View Campground
note: Campground on open grassland just north of Sturgis off Avalanche Rd (20497 Avalanche Rd): electric RV sites $37 a night, cabins; also a Sturgis Rally base. Online booking (ResNexus). --Claude
inclusion_evidence: AWH read 2026-10-03: electric site $37/night (ResNexus showed no rates to the headless browser out of season). Not on RV Life; Good Sam directory row -> published rate <= $50 passes; Google 4.7 over 108 at the address with phone
